subtitle.en: Source: nervosnetwork/fiber-scripts / contracts/funding-lock/src/main.rs　·　deployments: nervosnetwork/fiber config/mainnet|testnet/config.yml　·　mainnet 0xe45b…f4f1 / testnet 0x6c67…6d7c (type)

title.zh: 通道资金 → 承诺交易（双方 2-of-2 Schnorr 聚合签名）
title.en: Channel funding → commitment tx (2-of-2 aggregated Schnorr)

label.zh: funding cell（唯一 group 输入）

inputs.body:
Cell{ lock: { codeHash: FUNDING_LOCK, args: {{pubkey_hash 20B}} },
      type: xUDT?, capacity }

role.zh: blake160(双方 x-only 聚合公钥)
role.en: blake160(x-only aggregated pubkey of both parties)

label.zh: witness 字节布局（112 字节，非 WitnessArgs）
label.en: witness byte layout (112 bytes, not WitnessArgs)

role.zh: 空 WitnessArgs 占位，兼容 xUDT
role.en: empty WitnessArgs placeholder for xUDT compatibility

role.zh: x-only 聚合公钥（Schnorr 无法恢复公钥）
role.en: x-only aggregated pubkey (Schnorr cannot recover it)

cons.zh: 覆盖 blake2b(raw tx 去掉 cell_deps)

cond.zh: group 中只能有 1 个输入
exec ckb-auth（Schnorr，算法 7），消息 = blake2b(raw tx 去掉 cell_deps)（未检查）
cond.en: exec ckb-auth (Schnorr, algorithm 7), message = blake2b(raw tx without cell_deps) (not checked)

notes.zh: 错误码（main.rs Error）：1 IndexOutOfBound · 2 ItemMissing · 3 LengthNotEnough · 4 Encoding · 5 MultipleInputs · 6 WitnessLenError · 7 EmptyWitnessArgsError · 8 AuthError
notes.en: Error codes (main.rs Error): 1 IndexOutOfBound · 2 ItemMissing · 3 LengthNotEnough · 4 Encoding · 5 MultipleInputs · 6 WitnessLenError · 7 EmptyWitnessArgsError · 8 AuthError

notes.zh: 消息不含 cell_deps，因此可在不重签的情况下替换依赖（例如合约升级后）
notes.en: The message omits cell_deps, so deps can be swapped without re-signing (e.g. after an upgrade)
